definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of subtracting one number from another.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}が{苦手|にがて}だ。
{引|ひ}き{算|ざん}の{答|こた}えを{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To get the answer to a subtraction problem.

examples.japanese: {足|た}し{算|ざん}と{引|ひ}き{算|ざん}を{習|なら}う。

notes:
{引|ひ}き{算|ざん} means subtraction - one of the four basic arithmetic operations.

WORD FORMATION:
{引|ひ}く (to pull, subtract) + {算|さん} (calculation) = subtraction

THE FOUR BASIC OPERATIONS ({四則|しそく}{演算|えんざん}):
- {足|た}し{算|ざん}: addition (+)
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}: subtraction (-)
- {掛|か}け{算|ざん}: multiplication (×)
- {割|わ}り{算|ざん}: division (÷)

EXPRESSING SUBTRACTION:
- 10{引|ひ}く3は7: 10 minus 3 is 7
- 10から3を{引|ひ}く: subtract 3 from 10

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}をする: to do subtraction
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}の{問題|もんだい}: subtraction problem
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}が{得意|とくい}/{苦手|にがて}: to be good/bad at subtraction

RELATED MATH TERMS:
- {暗算|あんざん}: mental arithmetic
- {計算|けいさん}: calculation
- {答|こた}え: answer
- {差|さ}: difference (result of subtraction)
